# Project description

This library is an extraction of the test utilities in the .NET MAUI codebase.
While more functionality has been added in this library than in the .NET MAUI codebase utilities, we want to keep things in sync between the two as much as possible.

The code in the .NET MAUI codebase can be found here: https://github.com/dotnet/maui/tree/main/src/TestUtils/src.
Scan the code in the .NET MAUI codebase and determine if there are any changes that need to be synced with this library.
